system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Instructions in `AGENTS.md` override the default system prompt. Files are only loaded for trusted folders.
system_prompt_style.note: Default prompt prompts/cli.md plus AGENTS.md files, project scan; system_prompt_id can replace it.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Vibe automatically scans your project's file structure and Git status to provide relevant context to the agent
env_context_strategy.note: File-tree/git context injected plus grep/read tools for navigation.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compaction uses the built-in prompt at `prompts/compact.md` by default.
context_compaction.note: Auto-compaction tests exist (tests/agent_loop/test_agent_auto_compact.py); tool output bounding mentioned in ADR 0004 but mechanism not shown.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Keep tool output bounded and safe for LLM context, logs, and session transcripts.
observation_format.note: User @ image attachments are input, not tool observations.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: A tool has Pydantic args, result, config, and state types, and runs through `BaseTool`.
tool_call_format.note: Parser code not in evidence; inferred from typed schemas and provider adapters.

tool_count.note: README lists read, write_file, edit, bash, grep, todo, ask_user_question, task (~8) but tool registry not in evidence; managed shell variant adds more.

edit_primitive.note: edit argument format not shown; search_replace inferred.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Tools are typed, permissioned ports into side effects. A tool has Pydantic args, result, config, and state types

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Mistral Vibe can be used in text editors and IDEs that support [Agent Client Protocol]
protocol_standardization.note: MCP client via mcp_servers config; other = ACP (vibe-acp).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent loop communicates through typed events and streaming async generators.
loop_primitives.note: post_agent hook deny can inject retry (up to 3) - opt-in via hooks.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Manage a `todo` list to track the agent's work.
planning_granularity.note: plan agent profile and plan review events also exist.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The `task` tool allows the agent to delegate work to subagents
multi_agent_topology.note: task tool listed among default features; built-in explore subagent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Subagents run independently and can perform specialized work without user interaction, preventing the context from being overloaded.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: `accept-edits`**: The default agent. Auto-approves file edits only (`write_file`, `edit`).
human_in_loop.note: Default accept-edits asks for non-edit tools; ask/plan/auto-approve profiles; plan review event in ADR 0003.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Manage a `todo` list to track the agent's work.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Vibe discovers skills from multiple locations:
long_term_memory.note: AGENTS.md files re-injected; not agent-written memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: **`--continue`** or **`-c`**: Continue from the most recent saved session

self_verification.evidence_quote: `decision: "deny"` + `reason` — `reason` is injected as a new user message asking for a retry.
self_verification.note: Only via user-defined post_agent hooks (arbitrary command); closest value; no built-in verification shown.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Capped at **3 retries per hook per user turn**; further denies become terminal warnings.
retry_policy.note: Default no hooks -> one attempt; opt-in fixed_n(3) via post_agent hooks; /retry is manual.

rollback.note: Rewind manager exists (double-escape rewind); mechanism not shown. Worktree option is git-based.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `--max-turns N`**: Limit the maximum number of assistant turns. The session will stop after N turns.
termination_condition.note: --max-price and --max-tokens also; model_declared = turn ends without tool calls.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `--max-price DOLLARS`**: Set a maximum cost limit in dollars.

timeouts.evidence_quote: `tool_timeout_sec`: Timeout in seconds for tool execution (default 60s)
timeouts.note: MCP tools and hooks; run-level timeout not found.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Execute shell commands, with managed shell sessions, polling, and stdin helpers available during rollout.
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host; optional git worktree.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: reads and writes inside them don't require the "outside workdir" prompt
filesystem_access.note: Outside-workdir access requires approval rather than being blocked.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Mistral Vibe supports proxy configuration for environments that require network traffic to go through a proxy server.
network_policy.note: No egress restriction for agent actions in evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Shell permission analysis covers semantic execution rather than only top-level command text.
permission_model.note: Combined allowlists/denylists and per-call prompts for non-edit tools by default.

tracing.evidence_quote: Vibe can export traces for agent, model, and tool operations over OTLP/HTTP.

replayability.evidence_quote: Continue from the most recent saved session

eval_hooks.note: Only first 400 paths seen; no benchmark runner found.

guardrails.evidence_quote: `decision: "deny"` + `reason` — denies the tool call; `reason` becomes the tool error the LLM sees.
guardrails.note: OTEL redaction = output filter; pre_tool hooks and permissions = action policies.

open_source.evidence_quote: Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0

model_agnostic.note: Adapters for Anthropic, OpenAI responses, Vertex, Fireworks; local models.
